text: Welcome to the consultation. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress, I need to know your gestational age and whether there were any complications during delivery. Are you currently experiencing cyanosis, grunting, or flaring of the nostrils?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity at 33 weeks gestation.

Given the clinical presentation of respiratory distress at 2 hours of life in a preterm infant, I am requesting confirmation of the diagnosis with imaging. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray. Additionally, please inform me if the newborn is receiving oxygen support and what their heart rate currently is.
